operation.action: Operator-approved restart of the host PipeWire, WirePlumber and pipewire-pulse services. The installed minifuze2.service followed its PartOf dependency.

pipewire.note: The restart adopted the newer PipeWire already installed by host package updates; this check did not install or replace host packages.

digital_signal.name: post_restart_stereo_digital_signal
digital_signal.capture_note: pw-cat returned status 1 with empty stderr after producing exactly the requested 48000 stereo float32 frames. Signal metrics cover that complete buffer.

listening_after_recovery: Operator confirmed clean music in both headphones.

followup_recovery.action: After the subsequent suspend/resume check, the test client was saved, closed through its normal Quit action and relaunched. Its three selected MiniFuse links were restored and the session saved again.

limits: Audio was interrupted during the intentional host restart; this is not a seamless failover test.
The mixer service restarted through its systemd dependency; the engine process was not preserved.
Ardour kept its saved session open but its JACK audio engine stopped; automatic DAW reconnection did not pass.
The digital sample check covers one second of complete stereo data, not endurance or analog-output quality.
No suspend/resume, reboot, kernel upgrade or other sample rates are covered.
No serials, personal paths, voice or music are included.
